description_en: Stable grid with legacy 2010 parameters. No system stress.

description_es: Replicar exactamente las condiciones del 28 de abril: baja inercia, 78% renovables, penetraciÃ³n solar extrema.
description_en: Replicate exactly the April 28 conditions: low inertia, 78% renewables, extreme solar penetration.
outcome: Total system collapse. ROCOF exceeds 1.0 Hz/s. Synchronous machines trip. Cascade inevitable.
teaching_point: The exact conditions that led to the real blackout. Demonstrate why it was unstoppable.

name_en: Can We Save It With More Inertia?
description_es: Mismo evento (28A) pero con inercia aumentada a 4.5s (como si hubiera mÃ¡s plantas nucleares online).
description_en: Same event (28A) but with inertia increased to 4.5s (as if more nuclear plants were online).
outcome: Slower frequency decline. ROCOF stays below 1.0 Hz/s, avoiding pole-slip trips. UFLS can arrest the collapse.
teaching_point: Inertia delays the cascade but cannot prevent it without reserves. Shows why inercia is necessary but not sufficient.

description_es: Baja inercia fÃ­sica (2.45s) pero con alto FFR sintÃ©tico. En red dÃ©bil, causa inestabilidad.
description_en: Low physical inertia (2.45s) but high synthetic FFR. In weak grid, causes instability.
expected_behavior: Frequency oscillates violently at subsynchronous frequency (~0.63 Hz). Simulating PLL instability. FFR makes it worse, not better.
rocof_characteristic: ROCOF oscillates wildly. Amplitude increases. User sees control instability.
teaching_point: Synthetic inertia is NOT a drop-in replacement for physical inertia. In weak grids, high FFR gains cause the exact 0.63 Hz oscillation observed pre-blackout.

description_es: Explorar cuÃ¡ndo el UFLS puede salvar el sistema y cuÃ¡ndo es demasiado tarde.
description_en: Explore when UFLS can save the system and when it is too late.
outcome: With UFLS fully enabled, frequency arrest at ~48.2 Hz. Without UFLS, total collapse.
teaching_point: UFLS is the last line of defense. But in 28A, voltage instability rendered UFLS ineffective. Demonstrates non-linear coupling.
